note: Where kommuneskat + bundskat + mellemskat would exceed the 44.57% tax ceiling, the mellemskat rate is reduced by the difference (0% = no reduction). 20 of the 22 municipalities have a reduction in 2026.
source_title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Kommuneskattesatser 2026 (regneark, from 'Kommuneskatteprocenter siden 1977', page dated 31-10-2025)
